newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia hasn't had bid for Aer. Argentinas.
newsitem.headline: Iberia hasn't had bid for Aer. Argentinas.

text.p: Spain's Iberia said on Wednesday it had not received any offers for its interest in Aerolineas Argentinas and was undecided about the future of its stake in the group.
Spanish carrier Iberia was responding to reports from Brazil that the private Brazilian airline VASP had offered Iberia a deal to buy its stake in Aerolineas Argentinas.
"We have not received any firm offer," a spokesman from Iberia said.

Iberia said it currently owns 10 percent of the Argentine airline. The largest, 63 percent, stake is owned by Andes Holding, which is owned by Merrill Lynch, Bankers Trust and the Spanish government's holding company Teneo.
"Iberia is currently interested in designing a strategy of international alliances and Aerolineas Argentinas will play a role in this," a spokesman from Spanish state holding company SEPI said.
